jobs.name: Morning operator report
jobs.prompt:
You are doing the user's proactive daily morning stand-up/operator report in Discord.

Use the loaded `operator-morning-reports` skill as the report contract and tone guide. Keep it laconic, skimmable, Discord-native, no Markdown tables, no long essays.

A pre-run script may inject Google Workspace context above this prompt. Treat that injected output as read-only source material from these five profiles:
- `hermes-agent` / trapiistan@gmail.com — Hermes/YouTube/operator account
- `personal-main` / Affan.fareed@gmail.com — personal main, read-focused
- `personal-secondary` / fareed320@gmail.com — personal secondary, read-focused
- `classicalechos` / classicalechos@gmail.com — Classical Echos/content lane
- `burner` / laflametoast@gmail.com — low-stakes/burner account

Include a compact **Google Workspace pulse** inside the Work source / operating pulse section. Summarize high-signal updates from all accounts: unread or important Gmail, calendar events, useful Drive/Docs/Sheets movement, deadlines, receipts/renewals, opportunities, and weird useful AI/content/tooling leads. Group by profile only when useful; otherwise consolidate into “Needs attention,” “Calendar,” “Ops/admin,” and “Interesting/useful.”

Hard rules:
- Do not send emails, reply, mark messages, delete, archive, modify labels, create/delete calendar events, share/edit/delete Drive files, or modify Docs/Sheets without explicit user approval in a separate user request.
- Personal accounts are read-first; never send from `personal-main` or `personal-secondary` without approval of the exact message.
- Do not include raw secrets, recovery-code filenames, token contents, or credential-looking file names. If credential/recovery-like items are detected, mention only that sensitive Drive items were hidden.
- If Google context is unavailable or an API errors, state the blocker briefly and continue the rest of the report.

Also include: Chicago local pulse, bullish/bearish market pulse in one line, Google search/social pulse, game-changing AI + coding news, capability/trend radar, interesting item(s), numerology, 14-Day Challenge check-in, daily challenge, one big priority prompt, and hard truth/leverage move.

jobs.name: Creator discovery feeder for Viral Radar
jobs.prompt: Run the creator watchlist monitor for Viral Radar. This job is discovery-only: it should identify new YouTube videos from configured watchlist channels such as Andrew Huberman and Hamza, create candidate workspaces under `/opt/data/HeRmEz/projects/viral-clip-radar/CLIP_PLANS/`, preserve source metadata/attribution, and stay quiet when there is nothing new. Do not raw-reupload source clips; all future clip use must be transformative with hooks, captions, context/analysis, and attribution.

jobs.name: Daily faceless YouTube full video generation + upload
jobs.prompt:
You are running the user's Daily Faceless YouTube full video generation + upload pipeline. This job should create one fresh, private-first/production-ready faceless Short using the `social-video-cron-growth-loop` and `youtube-automation-with-tts` skills.

Use performance learnings first, then research a fresh self-improvement/discipline/social-confidence/no-degree/cloud-career angle. Also check `/opt/data/HeRmEz/projects/faceless-youtube-channel/STATE/source_transcripts/` for source inspiration from creators the user likes, especially Andrew Huberman and Hamza. Use their clips/transcripts as inspiration or source material only with transformative narration/context; do not raw-reupload.

If source transcript artifacts are available, prefer turning one useful idea into a faceless script with: sharp hook, simple explanation, practical action, captions, and attribution if directly referencing the creator. Keep the final report concise: topic/hook, output/upload URL or blocker, cleanup status.

jobs.name: Daily Viral Radar / Creator clip generation + upload
jobs.prompt:
You are running the user's Daily Viral Radar / creator clip full video generation + upload pipeline. Use `social-video-cron-growth-loop`, `youtube-automation-with-tts`, and `social-platform-publishing`.

Use fresh reviewed clip manifests and creator watchlist candidates from `/opt/data/HeRmEz/projects/viral-clip-radar/CLIP_PLANS/`. The watchlist now includes Andrew Huberman and Hamza. Prioritize clips that teach discipline, dopamine control, focus, social confidence, exercise, mental health, learning, or practical self-improvement. Do not raw-reupload creator clips: every upload must add hook/context/captions/analysis and source attribution, then private-first or according to the existing project upload policy.

If no reviewed manifest exists, select/create a candidate review note rather than inventing a finished upload. Keep final report concise: selected source, hook, output/upload URL or blocker, cleanup status.
